program.name: Kettlebell Legs
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Legs and glutes with one kettlebell: goblet squats and swings, deadlifts and lunges, then upper body.
program.about: Strong legs with a single kettlebell. One day is goblet and front squats with swings; the next is deadlifts, sumo work and lunges; the third presses and rows the bell for the upper body. Straight sets, steady rests. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for a heavier bell and Level III slows every rep down.
